name: UI Feedback Loop
description: Captures UI screenshots, generates feedback, frames tasks, then iteratively executes each improvement via sub-pipeline until all are complete

stages.name: Screenshot & Feedback
stages.description: Capture screenshot of live UI and generate comprehensive multi-perspective feedback

decisions.description: Feedback document generated and ready for framing

stages.name: Frame Implementation Tasks
stages.description: Convert feedback into specific, actionable code editing tasks (top 3 priority items)

decisions.description: Tasks are framed and ready for execution

stages.name: Execute Task via Sub-Pipeline
stages.description: Execute the next pending task using claude-task-v1 (plan → execute → validate)

stages.name: Track Progress
stages.description: Update progress document and determine if more tasks remain

decisions.description: More tasks remain in current batch - loop back to execute
Current batch complete but more improvements likely - re-analyze UI
UI looks great, no more improvements needed

flow.description: Screenshot → Frame 3 → Execute → Track → (more tasks | batch done → re-screenshot | all done)

connections.description: More tasks remain, execute next one
Batch complete, re-analyze UI for more improvements

metadata.author: Claude
metadata.purpose: Screenshot-driven UI improvement with iterative sub-pipeline execution
